name: QuarticFibre.cleared_fibre_factorization
statement: theorem cleared_fibre_factorization {K : Type} [CommRing K] (f m n q a b x y : K) (hcover : f*m^2=n^3+a*n*q^4+b*q^6) (hpoint : y^2=x^3+a*x+b) : f*m^2-y^2*q^6 = (n-x*q^2)*(n^2+n*x*q^2+x^2*q^4+a*q^4)

name: QuarticFibre.ordinate_denominator_inverse
statement: theorem ordinate_denominator_inverse {K : Type} [CommRing K] (f m y q yi qi : K) (hfibre : f*m^2=y^2*q^6) (hy : y*yi=1) (hq : q*qi=1) : m*(f*m*yi^2*qi^6)=1
